en: <CLT=cltMIND>This monitor has to be custom made...

<CLT=cltMIND>Why go out of their way to make this?
Where is this budget coming from?

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a giant green computer
in the middle of the room.

<CLT=cltMIND>This machine can make a new world...
What could that mean?

<CLT=cltMIND>This is where we found the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltMIND>
that gave us that memory, but...

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't help but feel like...there's more
to that memory than it seems.
